demos.heading: Before you run anything: set up the shell
demos.purpose: DocuMind can answer a tenant's questions from four stores: its own Vector Search index (the ANN tier), the Firestore rung beneath it, or two managed mirrors, Vertex AI RAG Engine and Vertex AI Search. make up pins acme to RAG Engine and zeta to Vertex AI Search so every store the course teaches is exercised. A managed store holds the text of every current version, but not the kit's addresses: its citations come back with ids like acme:acme_497809ff...#rag-532341da71fe, a page of null even for a PDF, and stages.retrieval_backend: rag_engine. This lesson reads the chunk ids of acme's answers and of the passages read back beside them, so point acme at the kit's own index for the duration and put the pin back at the end. Module 2 compares the four stores; Module 7 studies the mirrors.

demos.heading: Offline: nine quotes through both measures, and the gate's own lines over a stand-in API
demos.purpose: Do it: nine quotes, two measures The cell plays the API. Each row's /v1/query reply carries the row's figure and one citation, made by resolve() from a draft, so its quote reaches the gate exactly as rag-api would hand it on. Each row's /v1/passages reply is six handbook passages, the row's own clause first. Four rows are planted: lk-04 quotes its probation sentence under NP-03's number, lk-06 paraphrases, lk-08 leaves the quote empty, and lk-09's pool comes back without the passage it cites. The other six quote the first sentence of their clause.

A changed prompt needs a new version. Set prompt_version to "v4" in services/rag-api/config.py, then add

adaptations: The refusal is the observation: make prompt-version must exit 2 with the registry's own words for the edited text under the old label. Under the demo's set -e it stopped the step before the page's echo, and the kit was left on prompt-v4 with rule 5 edited (21 October 2026). Any other exit, or a 2 without those words, fails.
